result.summary: Found 1 issue: a loading spinner remains overlaid on the featured restaurant image in the 'Popular right now' section even though the photo has already rendered.

issues.description: The Tokumaru Ramen Bar card displays a circular loading spinner in the center of its image, even though the ramen photo is already visible behind it. The loading state was not dismissed, so the spinner obscures the hero image.
issues.suggestion: Remove the loading indicator once the image finishes loading so the restaurant photo is shown unobstructed.
